entries.name: Sushi roll (maki)
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours; an octagonal slice cut-face up: nori band, rice ring, salmon and cucumber filling. The pack models it squat (1.9 : 1), so at a real 0.03 m tall it is 0.057 m across, a futomaki-sized slice rather than a thin hosomaki

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 192 named a Quaternius static model on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge, off limits); the same artist's Ultimate Food Pack (Oct 2019) is on OpenGameArt as 'Low Poly Food Pack', CC0, the zip and pin of sushi-nigiri. Rendered both pack rolls: Sushi_Roll1 (salmon core only) and Sushi_Roll2 (salmon and cucumber core); Roll2 won, its two-colour filling reads as maki at a glance. Both have a full nori band. Colours (noon): rice in practical with a sky shade, as the nigiri and onigiri, so they share a plate; nori in iris (#5c3d32, the darkest noon hex above ink, so the band stays distinct from the outline), flat; salmon in accent with an iris shade at threshold 0.1 as the nigiri; noon has no green, so the cucumber takes skin, a pale tone that separates from the salmon and the rice. Static, no clips.
